function snapshot(checkpoint) {
	const { fixturePadding, ...resolvedInputs } = checkpoint.state.resolvedInputs;
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.expect)(typeof fixturePadding === "string" || fixturePadding === undefined).toBe(true);

		checkpointWithoutFixturePadding: {
			...checkpoint,
			state: {
				...checkpoint.state,
				resolvedInputs
			}
		},
		paddingRecipe: {
			field: "state.resolvedInputs.fixturePadding",
			present: fixturePadding !== undefined,
			character: "p",
			repeat: padding.length,
			sha256: sha(padding)
		},

		remainingBytes: __vite_ssr_import_3__.COMPLETE_CHECKPOINT_MAX_BYTES - bytes
	};
